caption: The drawing depicts a metallic, weathered-looking figurine of a human figure rendered in profile, kneeling on one knee and drawing a bow with an arrow aimed forward. The figure has a headdress featuring long, pointed spikes radiating outward and is dressed in a skirt-like garment with vertical stripes of muted red, yellow, and green. The face is stylized with a large eye, pronounced nose, open mouth, and distinct ear; the arm muscles and knee joints are accentuated with jagged edges. The entire figure is mounted atop a rectangular base that has symmetrical, abstract cut-out designs, largely consisting of circular and scroll-like elements. The color palette consists of rusty browns, with areas of faded red, yellow, and green on the skirt, all on a light cream background.
title: Indian Weather Vane
